thread:
Toni: Heads-up — I sketched a short proposal for per-route config ownership + runtime-scoped overrides. Want feedback before I turn this into an RFC. Main goal: let teams pin a config owner and a rollout window per route so ops can safely roll settings without cross-service surprise.
Kevin: Curious — is this additive to the existing flag hierarchy or a replacement? How does inheritance work for service -> route -> variant? :thinking_face:
Toni: Additive. Default hierarchy stays (global -> service -> route). New fields are: `owner`, `rollout_window` (ISO range), `scope` (route|service|global), and `shadow_apply: bool`. Example snippet:```json
{"scope":"route","owner":"team-payments","rollout_window":"2026-05-10/2026-05-12","shadow_apply":true}```
Maria: Nice. Can we ensure we surface rollout metrics in the console? We need a telemetry gate so PMs can stop a rollout if quality regresses.
Sam: Agree. Console proposals: small flag badge showing owner + a timeline scrubber for rollout_window, plus a one-click dry-run toggle that runs shadow_apply on 1% traffic. UI note: don't show owner until it's been claimed.
Liz: Audit concerns: if we allow route overrides, we must capture pre/post config snapshots and include them in the audit log export. Also need rehydration behavior for rollback — ensure KV caches are flushed or fallback could serve mixed configs.
Kevin: API question — how would clients request the effective config? We need to preserve backward compatibility for the /configs/effective endpoint. Proposal: add query param `as_of` and `include_shadow=true` so older SDKs keep working.
Toni: Migration plan I have in mind: 1) Schema + console fields behind feature flag, 2) shadow_apply default true for first 2 weeks, 3) telemetry gating on by default reporting metrics to `config.rollout.*` namespace. Key metrics: `rollout_apply_rate`, `rollout_failure_rate`, `config_apply_latency_ms`, `route_mismatch_count`.
ops-bot: Automation note — I've wired the dry-run job: `POST /automation/dryrun?route=...&pct=1` triggers an ephemeral shadow and emits `automation.dryrun.started`/`.finished` events to event-log. :robot_face:
Maria: What are thresholds for auto-pausing? I suggest auto-pause if `rollout_failure_rate > 0.5%` for 5m OR `route_mismatch_count` spikes 10x baseline. We should expose these as tunables per-team.
Sam: UX: default rollout batch sizes: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% with recommended hold times. Console will surface suggested hold-time based on `config_apply_latency_ms` percentile.
Liz: Operational playbook needs to be in repo before enabling. Steps: how to inspect shadow traces, how to force-revert, and how to rehydrate caches. Also add a runbook for `ops-bot rollback` that accepts `--snapshot-id`.
Kevin: Also add a small compatibility shim in SDKs: if `include_shadow` present, SDK will fetch both current and shadow and merge locally — helps smoke tests without platform changes.
Toni: Great feedback — I'll update the draft to include the schema snippet, telemetry names, auto-pause rules, SDK shim, and a minimal console mock. Will post RFC tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
summary: Thread discussing a proposal for per-route config ownership and runtime-scoped overrides, with schema snippet, migration plan, telemetry gates, console UX, API compatibility, and ops playbook.
